title: Flow Spotlight Suggestion Scroll
description: Make the flow canvas spotlight suggestion list scrollable when expanded via the chevron control.
summary: Made the flow spotlight suggestion list scrollable when expanded via the chevron. Restructured FlowSpotlight as a flex column with a dedicated scroll container (min-h-0, overflow-y-auto, viewport-capped max-height), wheel event isolation so canvas zoom does not steal scroll, and scrollIntoView for keyboard-active items. Added flowSpotlightSuggestionListScrollClass helper and unit tests.
